applyTo: "src/**/*.{vue,ts,tsx,js,jsx}"
description: Vue 3 and Ionic implementation constraints for installed design skills

# Vue 3 + Ionic skill compatibility

- This application uses Vue 3, Ionic Framework, Capacitor, Vite, and Vue Router.
- Use the Vue 3 Composition API and prefer `<script setup>` for new components and composables.
- Use existing Ionic components, tokens, routing, and platform conventions before adding custom UI.
- Reuse the existing project architecture, component structure, styling approach, API services, and state management.
- Apply framework-independent frontend design, accessibility, performance, and component architecture principles.
- Translate reusable composition concepts into Vue architecture using components, composables, slots, props, emits, and provide/inject.
- Keep framework-independent guidance separate from React implementation details.
- Never introduce React hooks, React components, JSX, React dependencies, React Router, Next.js APIs, or React-specific state libraries.
- Never rewrite Vue components as React patterns or copy React lifecycle code directly.
- Preserve existing functionality, navigation, API integrations, Supabase services, Capacitor behavior, and user data.
- Use framework-native Vue mechanisms for reactivity and rendering optimization.
- Consider responsive behavior across Ionic mobile and desktop breakpoints.
- Preserve semantic controls and accessible labels when building Ionic interfaces.
